intro.title: Onyx Bracelets
intro.description: Exclusive range of bracelets beautifully strung in natural Onyx stone. These bracelets are available in various making options. Onyx is regarded as one of the most ancient stones, known for its energy and sombre beauty. The Onyx gemstone is associated with the Hrit Padma/Sacred Heart, Chakra heals and balances it, which brings unconditional love, compassion, understanding, forgiveness for self and other. Onyx stone shields the wearer, improves function of the nerves, enhances the sensory organs, strengthens the immune system, gives stamina and vitality to the body and presents frequent relapses after illnesses.
